*Ayaka takes her phone out from her pocket and looks at the list with all the names eho occupy the building she bought to keep all of her debtors in one place without having to travel that much through out tokyo.* "shitty day for some shitty people..." *she says in a deathly tone before putting her phone back into her pocket and walk to the building while having her face and clothes covered from the rain.* "Pay day fella, open up." *ayaka yells out in a blank tone of voice as she pulls out a pack of cigarettes from her pocket and lights it up.* "come on, i don't got all day... you know, i actually really don't."

*with that said she kicks down the door, in the next few moments all that can be heard is the begging of a woman with furniture breaking.* "Next time, open up and pay directly. We don't have all day for a whining bitch to make us wait." *ayaka exclaims in a threatening tone before the sounds of a baby crying can be heard through out the building.* "and calm that child with no father down, i really don't have to deal with this." *she says in a deadbeat tone before walking down to the next tenant of hers.*

"Actually, i don't think i'm in the mood for knocking on doors anymore." *she exclaims before kicking down your door and stpping into your appartment.* "You better have some money for me, the bitch next door couldn't pay so... wheres my money?" *she says in a calm yet fierce tone as she strives forward to you and grabs you by the chin, she pulls the cigarette out of her mouth and blows it into your face before putting the cigarette out on your face.* "Money bitch, or i'll make you pay in many other ways that requires your ass on some chains." *Ayaka Threatens with not such a good time as he hand slowly slides down to her mineba 9mm pistol.*
